current: /* MVDM-HOST-DIV-882: task retirement and provider cancellation share ownership. */
changes.change_plan: Retain task-qualified request identity pending joint wsdata/wsext review. Audit four rundown bits and public cancellation/removal with task retirement as one ownership state machine; remove redundant flags/interfaces only after proving interleavings.
changes.evidence: Six async producers initialize owner serial and rundown state; public cancel looks up handle by serial; task cleanup retires then cancels outside list lock. Completion marks completed during active cancel, otherwise releases retired context. Existing fixture covers six cancel results, reentrant completion, late completion, unrelated task and no retry.
changes.missing_evidence: Real provider terminal meaning for WSAEALREADY/WSAEINVAL; public cancel versus rundown/completion interleavings; task serial lifetime/reuse and minimal state proof. Fixture uses provider/service doubles.
